event_summary.short: A man chased a family with a chainsaw and set their house on fire in Morristown, Tennessee. He was arrested after a foot pursuit and tasered and pepper sprayed by deputies. He was initially charged with attempted murder, but later convicted on lesser charges and sentenced to 40 years.
